areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Complementary objective, a women-leadership training product and indicators exist, but the theme is not central and the resource share is small.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Tax-system adaptation and simplification improve the business environment, with a related objective, component and indicators, but the resource share is low.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Complementary objective and a water-consumption indicator exist, but the resource share is tiny, so potential impact is not relevant.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Fiscal-transparency objective, product and a SMART indicator, but no primary component, low resources and no robust actions.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Extensive link to state capacity and federative cooperation, with components and indicators, but low resource share limits impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital-transformation objectives and product fit; resource share is low, though second largest among areas.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: General objective, specific objectives, components and indicators directly aligned; about half of resources; high but not exceptional impact; some indicators depend on external factors.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Uses technology and develops internal systems but does not contribute to the national science system or research or international cooperation.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Objective unrelated to the area, no clear energy indicators and a low resource share; some sustainability products are only loosely linked.
